Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Administrator user record granting full messaging management privileges.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was created.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Persistent real-time chat thread between an anonymous website visitor and the site administrator.

visitorId.description: Unique persistent anonymous visitor identifier (e.g., visitor_<random>).

visitorName.description: Optional display name for the visitor.

lastMessage.description: Preview text of the most recent message in the conversation.

lastSender.description: Who sent the most recent message.

unreadForAdmin.description: Count of messages unread by the administrator.

unreadForVisitor.description: Count of messages unread by the visitor.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the conversation.

visitorOnline.description: Whether the visitor currently has the site open.

visitorTyping.description: Whether the visitor is actively typing.

adminTyping.description: Whether the administrator is actively typing.

pageUrl.description: Last page URL visited by the visitor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the conversation started.

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message or activity.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual message inside a visitor conversation thread.

mediaUrl.description: Optional URL for attached image or file.

fileName.description: Optional file name for attached media.

read.description: Whether the recipient has read this message.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when the message was created.

/conversations/{visitorId}.description: Visitor conversation metadata documents indexed by visitorId.

/conversations/{visitorId}/messages/{mes.description: Subcollection of chronological messages belonging to a conversation.

schema.title: Post
schema.description: Published or draft blog article synced across production and preview.

schema.title: GalleryPhoto
schema.description: Photography gallery item synced across production and preview.

schema.title: CmsDoc
schema.description: Site content and configuration documents (about, homepage, settings).
